what_works: Off-white shell with one disciplined display face doing all the work — large headline rests against generous whitespace, and the gallery loads with a single line transition. For a boutique cleaning crew or high-end painter, the spareness reads as 'we charge more for a reason.'
what_does_not_translate: GSAP + BARBA.js page transitions are real engineering — keep the cream/charcoal restraint and the typographic confidence, render section changes as plain anchor jumps.
type_observations: One serif display at hero scale (~120px clamp) + one neutral sans body; the page is essentially a one-typeface conversation.
